description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the nursing team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to significantly impact patient care and staff development within a supportive environment.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of clinical excellence and regulatory compliance. This is a full-time position offering competitive compensation for a leader committed to quality healthcare.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Proven experience in nursing leadership, preferably in a skilled nursing facility
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations for long-term care
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $85,000 to $95,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.
